Free CRM Account

Grow faster than you ever thought possible with free CRM software from Agile CRM. We've made a complete set of sales and marketing features available for free, enabling your CRM to grow as your business scales.

Up to 10 Users

Agile CRM is free for ten users. With a complete feature set for sales and marketing, you can do so much more with a small team. Customize your dashboard, share data, launch your first campaign and instantly start qualifying leads.

Free Contact Management

Our free CRM software gives you 360-degree contact views with Facebook-style timelines. Social data and call histories. Email integration and web analytics. Agile CRM's contact management functionality provides next-gen capabilities that provide a greater ROI. Get going immediately with CSV import and export, then start tagging, segmenting and automatically engaging leads.

Marketing Automation

With Agile's free CRM software, marketing automation is a breeze. A drag-and-drop workflow designer streamlines and simplifies the creation of campaign workflows. Send newsletters, create autoresponders and automate lead scoring with powerful tools for customer engagement.

Popups and Surveys

Engage your web visitors with web popups and surveys, included with Agile's free CRM software. Automatically engage your leads and customers with personalized deals and responsive popup messages on your site or app. Combat exit intent, get useful feedback, and much more.

Free Reports by Email

Maintain deep insight into your results with best-in-class reporting for small businesses. Set up custom email reports in just a few clicks and automatically recieve email reports on on new leads, sales calls, paid conversions, and anything else you need to know about your sales and marketing.

Free Social Media CRM

Say hello to the first CRM designed for sales and marketing via social media. Monitor Twitter streams, schedule tweets and capture more leads with our Social Suite. Add Facebook, Twitter, G+ (Google Plus) and TowerData (Rapleaf) widgets to contact pages, and even include social media in automated campaigns!

Plugins and Integrations

Our free CRM software lets you integrate with your favorite third-party plugins like Twitter, Facebook for social and Twilio, VoIP, RingCentral for calling and start selling like a Pro.

Extensive API

Powerful front-end & back-end API in REST, JavaScript, Java, PHP, C# and Ruby, with components APIs for our awesome popups, landing pages, nodes and widgets. Easily exchange data between your favorite new CRM and your web services.

Trusted by Over 15,000+ Customers & 170,000+ Users

Co-founder - IKO System

I've seen and used dozens of CRMs. This one may change the market upside down. Absolutely great, easy-to-use and powerful.

Gary Tramer

Sales and Business Development - Espresso Logic

Agile CRM is an exciting and powerful system. The capability to create complex workflows to customize our interaction with prospects is immensely useful and easy - simply a matter of drag and drop.

Megan Pillsbury
Operations Director - Applied Wine

We like Agile CRM because it's built for a combination of offline/online business, like a SaaS company that manages enterprise deals. It's full of features, but doesn't feel cluttered as they keep things clean and simple. And we love that they keep adding integrations.
